# Generated by `cargo run -p agent_docs` from the diagnostic registry and compiler/tests/ui; do not edit.
title: "W4010 catch_all_on_open_union"
description: "A catch uses _ => … on an error union that may grow."
---

A warning from the `pattern` phase. `sakura explain W4010` prints this explanation offline.

A `catch` uses `_ => …` on an error union that may grow. New error tags would be silently
swallowed; list the tags instead (design §5.3).

Warning:

```sakura
fn or_default<T, E>(body: fn() -> T ! {Fail<E>}, default: T) -> T {
  try { body() } catch { _ => default }
}
```

Fixed:

```sakura
fn or_default<T>(body: fn() -> T ! {Fail<Refused | Timeout>}, default: T) -> T {
  try { body() } catch { Timeout => default, Refused => default }
}
```

## Fixed program

[`compiler/tests/ui/W4010_catch_all_on_open_union.fixed.sak`](https://github.com/icantcodefyi/sakuralang/blob/main/compiler/tests/ui/W4010_catch_all_on_open_union.fixed.sak), which `sakura check` accepts with no diagnostics:

```sakura
error Timeout

error Refused

fn or_default<T>(body: fn() -> T ! {Fail<Refused | Timeout>}, default: T) -> T {
  try { body() } catch {
    Timeout => default,
    Refused => default,
  }
}
```
